purpose: Existing local evidence inventory for minimum-cost Luna/Astra routing; no new experiments or compiles.

comparisons.kind: source-recovery cohort; not a model comparison
comparisons.starting_identity: Frozen baseline queue input 675b5e72355eccb1a556a303a14473eac416cb19fb400d466e4f39af98ee48ee; 7 routine source-eligible cases selected before attempts.
comparisons.tools_permissions: Pinned historical compiler and durable grinder; one source/recipe/manifest writer; cards and frozen diagnostic packets; per-task budget 3; trial/source/object identities in reports.
comparisons.outcomes: Nine compiler outcomes over three unresolved functions: eight informative negatives and one redundant repeat; toupper matched and passed fresh strict promotion; mmgr_copy_paras precompiler-blocked; sub_35DE6 and file_load_shape2d_palmap_init skipped for binding evidence.
comparisons.stop: Routine three-failure/task workflow gates; 13 rounds include two no-compile evidence reviews. Not global model exhaustion.
comparisons.usage: Batch usage.json has model-separated aggregate token telemetry and API-equivalent Standard/Fast scenarios, including root/supervisor work. It is not reliably attributable per case or to a strict solve; Codex invoice/service tier unknown.

comparisons.kind: same-model extended-workflow sample; not a matched short-vs-long or model comparison
comparisons.starting_identity: Purposeful 12-case sample reuses batch001 history; inherited starting states are post-short-budget and differ by case. Pinned MSC 5.10 medium; no matched Astra-from-start arm.
comparisons.tools_permissions: Isolated research candidates/receipts; broad source/ABI/TU/caller/mapping research; production writer and acceptance controls unchanged; case quotas sum 34 with 4 reserve and 2 safety slots.
comparisons.outcomes: Five repeats are same-source MSC 5.0/5.10 controls; three repeat already-ineffective source forms. B4 objects were recovered via generic reader/diagnostics but strict production parsing/binding remains a gate. No exact endurance promotion. The separate palmap continuation added one charged process (42 total across batch, endurance, and continuation), established a 40-byte object observation, and had no strict promotion because padding-byte ownership was unproven.
comparisons.stop: Case-quota, evidence/convergence and pinned-tool capability gates; the later palmap continuation used one additional process. Total is 42/50 (10 batch + 31 endurance + 1 continuation), leaving 8 unused (3 case, 3 reserve, 2 safety). Purposeful sample is not a repo solvability estimate.
comparisons.usage: No per-trial tokens in endurance ledger; current batch aggregate contains later cohort activity but not auditable model cost per case/solve.

comparisons.kind: matched evidence-presentation comparison, not model comparison or source solve test
comparisons.starting_identity: Baseline git 98be0015e3354f54d7b045a136d783965d1eaaa5; four real-function packets X=islands/Y=family summary, per-file SHA-256s in advice-comparison/design.json.
comparisons.tools_permissions: Fresh isolated agents, same source/oracle facts and proposal prompt; up to four evidence reads; one proposal; no compilation; root knew history; unblinded assessment.
comparisons.outcomes: Y reduced aggregate usage 10.3% and wall time 7.9%, largely by avoiding a rectangle reread, but did not consistently improve proposal quality; one selected source explanation was weaker. No recovery-throughput inference.
comparisons.usage: Per-run actual cumulative usage and wall times recorded in usage.json; cached input repeats, not unique context size or cost.

comparisons.kind: matched proposal packets; model and reasoning setting confounded
comparisons.starting_identity: Same frozen Y rectangle and pointer packets, prompt and four-read allowance used previously by Astra/medium; hashes in advice-comparison/design.json.
comparisons.tools_permissions: Same proposal-only tool/read permissions; no compile; one run per case/configuration; no randomization or replication.
comparisons.outcomes: Luna abstained on rectangle where Astra proposed a falsifiable parameter/register test; pointer proposals both explored shifts, but Astra specified the distinction more precisely. Proposal observations only.
comparisons.stop: One-shot allowance; selected after presentation study.
comparisons.usage: Actual per-run token/time telemetry exists; Luna high vs Astra medium cannot isolate model from reasoning setting; API service tier and subscription cost unknown.

api_equivalent_deployment_cost_scenarios.basis: Standard and Fast API-equivalent scenarios from the repository pricing reference; these are alternatives, reasoning is included in output, cached input is a subset of total input, and no supervisor work is assigned. This is not actual Codex billing or a solve-cost comparison.
api_equivalent_deployment_cost_scenarios.long_context: No long-context adjustment: aggregate input for each run is below 272000 tokens, therefore every constituent request is also below threshold.
api_equivalent_deployment_cost_scenarios.interpretation: Deployment-configuration cost illustration for two proposal tasks only; no compiler runs, strict matches, or model-capability inference.

comparisons.starting_identity: Two bounded tasks; archived source histories and pinned compiler; six source attempts total.
comparisons.tools_permissions: Ordinary grinder and production strict promotion path; no matched Astra run.
comparisons.outcomes: copy_string produced an exact 56-byte contribution on meaningful hypothesis 3 and passed fresh whole-image strict promotion compile 0004. nopsub_326BA failed after three hypotheses (34/52/34 vs 36B).
comparisons.stop: Per-task 3-hypothesis cap for nopsub; copy_string stopped at strict promotion.
comparisons.usage: One Luna session: 2,269,388 cumulative tokens, 99,126 uncached input, 16,278 output (8,942 reasoning subset), 542.6 seconds; parent review/promotion/validation excluded. No Astra comparator.

comparisons.kind: retrospective compiler outcomes; model comparison unsupported
comparisons.starting_identity: 13 functions, 43 nonduplicate outcome records (14 grinder, 22 research, 7 legacy promotion rows); source/object/recipe links vary by record.
comparisons.tools_permissions: Compiler receipts and strict promotions recorded for many outcomes; equivalent packet, evidence, permission, and tool identities not consistently recoverable.
comparisons.outcomes: Historical successes can seed blind replays only after reconstructing and hiding post-solution artifacts. Counts are rows, not independent task samples.
comparisons.stop: Historical archive; no model-specific stop budget reliably recorded.
comparisons.usage: Model, reasoning, and token accounting are null/unknown.

limits: No actual same-reasoning-level Astra-vs-Luna source-compilation comparison exists.
No per-solve API cost attribution exists; subscription usage, API service tier and long-context applicability differ or are unavailable.
Historical report model/reasoning and usage are unknown; promotion totals cannot become model-specific attempt distributions.

Late exact outcomes are sparse: batch toupper at hypothesis 1, copy_string at hypothesis 3, no strict win after hypothesis 3 in endurance or its palmap continuation; purposeful cases and unmatched history do not estimate repository rates.
Selection/endurance are purposeful samples over a small subset of 599 SUPERVISOR queue items; do not generalize solved-only or selected-case rates to the repository.
A replay candidate is not permission to reopen a blocked source task; current queue budgets/production invariants remain authoritative.

Only copy_string has both genuine archived nonmatching source seeds and a subsequent exact candidate on the same trajectory plus strict promotion; rect_compare_point has a research exact observation after negatives but its promoted source differs.
